summary: Citius Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K regarding a Third Amendment to a Promissory Note with its majority-owned subsidiary Citius Oncology. The amendment aligns payment and maturity terms with a new subordination agreement related to Citius Oncology's debt facility, extends maturity to 91 days after full repayment of senior debt, eliminates prior maturity triggers tied to capital raises, prohibits cash prepayment, and adds a voluntary conversion feature at $0.90 per share. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event is involved; this is a routine debt modification between parent and subsidiary.
